notes: The "Ghost-Eye 600M" is Cine Gears' M-series wireless HDMI/SDI video transmission kit, sold as a matched Transmitter + Receiver pair (also available as separate TX-only or RX-only SKUs, and as an "600MP" L-series-battery variant). Ports listed here combine the official M-Series Transmitter and M-Series Receiver interface diagrams from Cine Gears' own manual covering the 600M/1000M/800T family (same hardware/connector layout across the M-series range; only transmission distance differs between 600M/1000M). The 800T/800TC T-series variants add TALLY I/O and a 3.5mm MIC/HP jack not present on the plain 600M units and were excluded. SDI grade (3G-SDI Type A/B) is confirmed on Cine Gears' product/retail pages and B&H's listing rather than explicitly in this manual's spec table, so it is inferred (medium confidence). HDMI version is not stated anywhere; system max is 1080p up to 60fps, 10-bit 4:2:2, <1ms latency, 5.1-5.9GHz (region-dependent) with a 2.4GHz control link. Antenna connectors (RPSMA on transmitter x2/5G, SMA 2.4G on receiver) and the V-mount/L-series battery clips are physically present but omitted as ports since there is no matching connector id in the given list. Power input connector is physically a 2-pin LEMO (9-18V DC), approximated here as "dc-barrel" since LEMO is not in the allowed connector list.

ports.name: SDI IN
ports.note: Transmitter. 3G-SDI Type A/B support stated on Cine Gears retail listings, not explicit in this manual table.

ports.name: HDMI IN
ports.note: Transmitter. HDMI version not stated by manufacturer (max signal 1080p60, 10-bit 4:2:2).

ports.name: Power Supply IN (Lemo)
ports.note: Transmitter DC input, 9-18V. Physical connector is a 2-pin LEMO, not a barrel jack; 'dc-barrel' used as closest available id. Unit also has a Sony V-mount/L-series battery clip (mechanical mount, not listed as a port).

ports.name: SDI OUT 1
ports.note: Receiver, dual SDI output (SDI OUTx2 in manual).

ports.name: SDI OUT 2
ports.note: Receiver, second of dual SDI outputs.

ports.name: HDMI OUT
ports.note: Receiver. HDMI version not stated by manufacturer.

ports.name: Power Supply IN (Lemo)
ports.note: Receiver DC input, 9-18V. Physical connector is a 2-pin LEMO; 'dc-barrel' used as closest available id. Unit also has a Sony V-mount battery clip (mechanical mount, not listed as a port).

ports.name: BAT-out
ports.note: Receiver auxiliary DC power output for external accessories, sourced from the mounted battery. Exact connector style not specified in the manual; mapped to closest available id.
